metadata.title: Raw JSON-RPC MCP Wire Trace — package-registry server
metadata.model_call_location_statement: The model call happens ONLY inside the host agent between tools/list (when discovered tool schemas are provided to the LLM) and tools/call (when the LLM selects a tool); the MCP server is a standalone deterministic JSON-RPC process that NEVER calls an LLM.

annotations.id: Client-allocated correlation ID (integer 1) matching this request to its response.
annotations.method: MCP lifecycle method 'initialize' initiating capability handshake.
annotations.params: Object containing client protocol version ('2024-11-05'), client capabilities, and clientInfo metadata.

annotations.id: Correlation ID (1) confirming this response matches initialize request #1.
annotations.result: Payload containing server protocolVersion ('2024-11-05'), server capabilities (tools list support), and serverInfo ('package-registry' v1.0.0).

annotations.method: MCP lifecycle notification 'notifications/initialized' signaling handshake completion.
annotations.id: Absent (strictly null/omitted) because JSON-RPC notifications expect no response.
Client correlation ID (integer 2) for the tools discovery request.
annotations.method: MCP method 'tools/list' querying all tools exposed by this server.

tools.name: get_package_version_metadata
tools.description: Retrieve package metadata, latest published version, dependencies, license, and runtime requirements from DevRel's package registry.

package_name.description: Name of the package, e.g. 'ledgerline' or 'ledgerline-python'

tools.name: get_package_release_dates
tools.description: Retrieve the complete release history timeline and publication dates for all versions of a package from the registry.

tools.name: get_package_deprecation_notices
tools.description: Query official deprecation warnings, sunset timelines, and migration paths for specific package versions in DevRel's package registry.

annotations.result: Object containing 'tools' array: list of tool definitions with name, description, and inputSchema conforming to JSON Schema.

annotations.id: Client correlation ID (integer 3) for tool execution.

annotations.result: Object containing 'content' array with text/image items, and boolean 'isError' (false for successful execution).
